title: Ice and Fire - Programmer Art
description: Ice and Fire textures ported from 1.12.2
body:
This resource pack ports textures from the 1.12.2 version of Ice and Fire to the modern version. It has only been tested with the 1.20.1 Fabric version of Ice and Fire CE, though it should be fully compatible with other versions of the mod.

**Some textures are still missing!** Future updates addressing these are unlikely, though I am always open to submissions.

Most textures are taken directly from [Ice and Fire](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ice-and-fire-dragons) under the GNU Lesser General Public License. A select few are custom made for this resource pack.
